name: The approach
brief: The jungle below the base. No buildings: land, a trail, what grows on it, and what a patrol has parked across it. The controls are taught on the way, and two places ask for a sneak.
template: This file is a starter, not the game. Everything in it is a word to change: where cover stands, how each watcher walks and looks, what each hint says, where the two points begin and end. `plan.mjs`-style laws (level0.mjs --plan) say what a change did: whether the first try is still seen, whether a way unseen is left, what it costs.

watchers.reads: walks through the gap in the convoy and back
walks the front of the convoy
stands at the camp's edge and watches the trail come up and the open ground east of it
stands behind the carrier and watches the camp's back, up the slope
walks the trail past the camp

points.reads: a convoy parked across the land: one gap on the trail, walked by a patrol, and a slot at its far end
a camp beside the trail: a lookout on the trail, a guard on its back, a patrol past it

hints.says: W A S D to run. The mouse looks.
C crouches. Hold C to lie down, and hold it again to stand. Low, you are harder to see, and you make no sound.
The fan on the ground is what a guard sees. Cover lower than you hides you only when you are lower than it.
A run is heard from close by. A patrol walks a round: wait for its back.
E behind a guard who has not seen you takes it down. Hold the right mouse to aim; a shot is heard a long way off.
An outpost. The trail is watched. There is more than one way past, and the slow ones are the safe ones.
